Sony Music Direct |catalogue_number=MHCL-30606~8, MHCL-30609 |tracks=N/A |colorscheme=Alola}} '''Mewtwo Strikes Back Evolution Music Collection''' (Japanese: '''「ミュウツーの逆襲 EVOLUTION」ミュージックコレクション''') is the Japanese soundtrack for the [[M22|twenty-second movie]]. It was released in Japan on July 24, 2019 in two versions: Limited Edition and Regular Edition. The Limited Edition box set includes a bonus disc containing a digital remaster of the [[Sound Picture Box - The Birth of Mewtwo|soundtrack]] to the [[M01|first movie]], goods, a picture label, and a color booklet.
